name: TencentCloud Captcha
description: Integrates TencentCloud Captcha with the CAPTCHA module.
project_description:
Integrate Tencent Cloud Captcha services with Captcha module to protect Drupal with great captcha experiences.

 For Drupal 8.x version: Some original works of this module can be found at Tencent-Cloud-Plugins/tencentcloud-drupal-plugin-captcha , which might work with Drupal 8 and early versions of Drupal 9.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 Following module and package will be included automaticlly when installed with composer.

- Captcha module.

- tencentcloud/captcha:^3.0 package

- Account of Tencent Cloud Captcha Console .

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further information, see Installing Drupal Modules .

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 1. Create and get SecretId and SecretKey from Tencent Cloud API 

2. Create graphic captcha (图形验证) and get CaptchaAppId and AppSecretKey from Tencent Cloud Captcha Graphic 

3. Go to Tencent Cloud Captcha config page at /admin/config/people/captcha/tencentcloud_captcha to fill above info and choose which forms to protect.

4. (Optional) Goto Captcha config page at /admin/config/people/captcha to implement to other forms.

 Back to top
